data.name: Naushazaad
data.short_meaning: New creation or born of new
data.long_meaning: The name Naushazaad is derived from Persian words 'Nau' meaning new and 'Shazad' meaning prince or born of noble. It signifies a new creation or a noble birth.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, the name signifies a fresh start or a new beginning, aligning with the concept of a believer being born again through faith.
data.numerology_meaning: A name for a girl who is nurturing, loving, and caring. She has a strong desire to help others and is always ready to lend a hand. She is creative and artistic, and has a natural ability to heal and soothe those around her.

in_arabic.name: نوشازاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوشازاد هو اسم مشتق من كلمتين فارسيتين معناه الابن الجميل والمتفوق، ويعود أصوله إلى الثقافة الإسلامية الفارسية، ويشير إلى الشخص المتفوق في الجمال والخلق، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالة روحية عالية في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: نوشازاد
